name: Hotel Clio, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Denver Cherry Creek
insider_take: This sophisticated boutique gem puts you at the epicenter of Denver's most prestigious shopping district, where Rocky Mountain elegance meets cosmopolitan flair.
whats_special: Hotel Clio occupies a prime spot in Cherry Creek North, Denver's answer to Rodeo Drive, surrounded by over 160 upscale boutiques and galleries. The hotel's rooftop offers stunning views of the Front Range mountains, while its intimate 202-room design ensures personalized service that larger properties can't match. As part of Marriott's elite STARS program, guests enjoy exclusive perks like complimentary breakfast and room upgrades.
pro_tip: Book a mountain-view room on floors 8-14 for breathtaking sunrise views of the Rockies, and time your visit during fall when the nearby Cherry Creek Trail explodes with golden aspen colors.
dont_miss: The Cherry Creek Bike Path runs right behind the hotel—perfect for morning jogs with mountain views. Explore the nearby Denver Art Museum (10 minutes away) and the iconic Cherry Creek Shopping Center, home to Colorado's only Neiman Marcus. The hotel's location also puts you minutes from the historic Country Club neighborhood, where Denver's elite built stunning mansions in the early 1900s.
pros: Prime Cherry Creek location with upscale shopping and dining nearby
Sophisticated modern design with luxury amenities
Marriott STARS Program benefits including room upgrades and VIP treatment
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury collection properties
Urban setting may lack mountain views
